receiver_state_definitions.loss_ratio: unit1; mature expected local slots not received before strict generation+TTL; includes unsent expected slots
receiver_state_definitions.consecutive_missing: packet; trailing mature missing sequence slots
receiver_state_definitions.observation_ns: ns; local window close/available time, consumed strictly before actor decision

legacy_state_disposition: old global accepted-TX/reference and initial runtime flags are separate; no actor-control causality claim from those flags
application_message_policy: modeled report payload frozen at submission and bound to exact native flow/packet RX through immutable ledger; not hardware ACK or PX4 receipt

corrections.change: activate backup discovery at locally observed arrival at authored backup-loiter endpoint; avoid unsupported pre-contact ARP resolution
response delay starts at actor-observed loss, not station global truth
failed primary tower does not confirm a receiver-private response; retain event ID and log exact backup endpoint
move the backup contact endpoint toward the already authored backup station; retain velocities, patrol destination and landing route

assumptions: receiver-visible periodic heartbeat is configured application traffic
actor observes local weather/nearby geometry after one original tick
10Hz authored waypoint engine, not PX4 aerodynamic flight
rain_rf: not amplified; dimensionless rain is not an observed mm/h rate

backup_request_policy.pose_source: executed owner trajectory, modeled local navigation observation
backup_request_policy.station_authority: actual exact-owner request RX only; no actor arrival/global event knowledge

backup_contact_geometry.scope: L2-1_v2 only; original published script/scene unchanged
backup_contact_geometry.basis: unchanged-route native ARP cache drops and backup PREAMBLE_DETECT_FAILURE; no RF threshold/power change

spatial_check.meaning: existing fitted source geometry, including declared fallback heights; not surveyed obstacle clearance

backup_contact_geometry.rf_scope: same R1 ns-3 PHY/MAC; contact feasibility is measured by native request/response RX, not by a calculated range alone

backup_discovery_policy: actor reaches its versioned backup-contact endpoint, samples its own actual arrival, observes it after one tick, then begins backup request strictly after availability
landing_authority: preloaded onboard mission termination after receipt-admitted patrol resumption; no new failed-path landing command assumed
